feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 16 October 2026 8:22am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 16 October 2026 at 7:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Starting dry with sunny spells today, before a few showers arrive during the afternoon and evening. Mainly moderate west winds, gradually veering northwest and freshening near windward coasts. Maximum temperature 13°C.

A settled weekend ahead:
Tomorrow will be dry and sunny with light northeast winds. Sunday will continue dry and mostly sunny, again with light northeast winds. Temperatures will be near average to rather cold. Maximum temperature 12°C.


##Outlook##

High pressure will gradually progress eastwards to Northern Europe on Monday, but conditions should remain mostly dry with sunny intervals and light to moderate winds to start the week.
